id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|ce4: "Ah, gentlemen. How was our steam bath? Please come again if you like.

id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|163c: "Oh, sir. Are you here for the steam bath?
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|17a0: "Then I'll have you change. Please wait a moment...
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|1a80: "It'll be a long journey, right? Before Gallopolis, Veronica will teach you a very handy spell.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|1bd0: "...There, done. If you cast Zoom, you can instantly go to any town you've visited.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|1c84: "If you want to come back here, choose Hotto from Zoom in the Spells menu, and you can return.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|1d3c: "Now that you've learned Zoom, let's set off to find the Great Tree's branch. Our goal is Gallopolis, in the southwest desert!
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|207c: "Beyond here is Gallopolis territory. Those without a pass may not go through.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|2130: "If you want rest, head northeast to a small village called Hotto.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|224c: "What's this? Beyond here is Gallopolis territory. Show your pass if you want to go on.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|2718: "Northeast of here is Hotto. West is Gallopolis territory.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|27b8: "I hear a monster appeared near Hotto, and in Gallopolis there's an uproar over a star falling on the Celestial Sands.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|28a8: "Neither northeast nor west looks restful, but if you need an inn, go wherever you like.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|29a0: "Oh... {var:1}. I've heard rumors of you. Please, go right through.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|2a68: "Gallopolis is in an uproar since a dark, ominous sun appeared over the Celestial Sands...
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|2b28: "I wonder if my family is safe... How is the Sultan faring...? Ugh, I hate that I can't leave my post.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|2d04: "Hey! Who are you? Beyond here is Gallopolis territory. Those without a pass may not go through.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|2de4: "If you want rest, head northeast to a small village called Hotto.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|2ee0: "Hey! Who are you? Beyond here is Gallopolis territory. Do you have a pass?
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|33b0: "Traveler, you look tired. Is something troubling you?
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|34c4: "Hm, is that so... I don't know what happened, but a steam bath will ease your mind.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|35d0: "Lady Miko says nothing, but surely no one grieves Lord Ryu's death more deeply.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|3678: "The other day I peeked into Lady Miko's room and heard her weeping, stifling her voice. Even I felt my chest ache.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|37a0: "This village has a legend of a sacred treasure called the Yata Mirror, said to reflect the clear truth.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|3864: "But no one knows where it is. It's wrapped in mystery. I'd love to see it once.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|398c: "Lady Miko was eaten by the firedrake!! What are we to do...
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|3a08: "I... I can't think. Is Hotto finished...?
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|3acc: "After Lord Ryu died, Lady Miko hid the still-living firedrake from everyone and tried to offer sacrifices to it...
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|3bb8: "Lady Miko's end was truly baffling. If she had reasons, she could have told us priests.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|3ce4: "Though our master is gone, we still have things to do.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|3d74: "I believe keeping Hotto going with our own strength is the best farewell gift for Lady Miko.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|3e60: "Thinking back, perhaps we put all the responsibility on Lady Miko and pushed everything onto her.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|3f24: "Lady Miko... we will keep the village you protected alive, so please watch over us...
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|4038: "Traveler, did you need Lady Miko? Unfortunately, she's out right now.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|41f0: "Traveler, did you need Lady Miko? Unfortunately, she's out right now.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|40d8: "If word got out that Lady Miko is away, the villagers would panic. Please keep this secret.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|4290: "If word got out that Lady Miko is away, the villagers would panic. Please keep this secret.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|43a8: "Lady Miko and Lord Ryu aren't merely strong. Their very presence gives us courage.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|4558: "Lady Miko and Lord Ryu aren't merely strong. Their very presence gives us courage.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|4458: "What do they call that power abroad... fusuma... tokonoma... no, um, oh yes, charisma!
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|4608: "What do they call that power abroad... fusuma... tokonoma... no, um, oh yes, charisma!
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|48dc: "This building is where Hotto iron is born. The sand of Mount Huji is very dark, and ideal for ironmaking.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|49e0: "Heat black sand over a strong fire and out comes bright, beautiful iron. Like magic, isn't it?
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|4ae4: "Hey, traveler. Sneaking in at this hour of night... You wouldn't be a wanted man, would you?
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|4bac: "Ha! Just kidding. A peaceful-looking guy like you couldn't be wanted.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|4c48: "This is Hotto, a village of smithing and hot springs, living off the volcano's blessings. Enjoy the sights.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|4d88: "Ha! Sorry about before. This is Hotto, a village of smithing and hot springs. Enjoy the sights.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|4e50: "Still, you look less like a wanted man than someone bad guys would fleece. Watch out for strangers on your travels.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|4f84: "In Hotto we have a custom of making offerings to the fire god of Mount Huji.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|5034: "We used to offer rice and crops, but food ran short, so next we finally...
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|50f0: "...No, never mind. It has nothing to do with an outsider like you. Pretend you didn't hear.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|51cc: "Lady Miko is a great man. She always puts us villagers first in everything she does.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|5284: "Everyone here has relied only on the fire god and Lady Miko's word. That's how this village has gone on.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|5390: "Idiot! If you go over there, the firedrake will eat you! Do you want to die?!
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|5460: "Given what Lady Miko did, there's a lot that looks fishy, so I understand why everyone doubts her...
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|5520: "...I can't blame Lady Miko. In the end, we just did as we were told without thinking.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|5620: "I can say this now. Thank you for defeating the firedrake before we made the sacrifice.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|57f0: "I can say this now. Thank you for defeating the firedrake before we made the sacrifice.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|56e8: "If we'd really done it, even if our lives were spared, we'd have gone to hell after death...
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|58b8: "If we'd really done it, even if our lives were spared, we'd have gone to hell after death...
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|59c0: "This ironworks is where Hotto iron is born. Heat black, powdery sand until it glows, and it melts into red-hot iron.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|5bd4: "This ironworks is where Hotto iron is born. Heat black, powdery sand until it glows, and it melts into red-hot iron.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|5ac0: "That sand is common on Mount Huji, but there are too many scary monsters now. We can hardly go collect it.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|5cd4: "That sand is common on Mount Huji, but there are too many scary monsters now. We can hardly go collect it.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|5de8: "Iron sand is so hard to get lately, I was about to close shop... but if Lord Ryu is back, I'd better keep going.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|5fc4: "Iron sand is so hard to get lately, I was about to close shop... but if Lord Ryu is back, I'd better keep going.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|5ebc: "Lord Ryu is our best sword customer in this village. For his sake, I can't quit.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|6098: "Lord Ryu is our best sword customer in this village. For his sake, I can't quit.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|632c: "Brr... Was that the famous ghost or spirit I just heard...?
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|639c: "You plan to use the steam bath here? A word of warning: don't!
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|649c: "I heard a ghostly voice at the steam bath just now. I fled in a panic.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|6538: "You went into the steam bath, right? Nothing happened?
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|65c0: "I see... then fine. But I'm not up for another scare. I'll never use a steam bath again.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|66ac: "...What? That voice wasn't a ghost but a lost child crying? Geez, you scared me.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|67a4: "I'm not up for another scare. I'll never use a steam bath again.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|6878: "That voice in the steam bath wasn't a ghost but a lost child? Tch, I got scared for nothing.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|69a0: "There's no such thing as ghosts. I was just drunk. Yes, that must be it.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|6a20: "Well, I'm getting chilly. Think I'll take another steam bath.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|6af4: "I thought your face looked like someone's, and now I remember: Lady Miko's son, Lord Ryu.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|6ba8: "Maybe more your character than face? You can't leave people in trouble alone. You're alike there too.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|6e34: "Once we do that ritual, there's no turning back... Ugh... but still...
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|6ec8: "...You were listening? The ritual will come out sooner or later. I'm not hiding it, but leave me be for now.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|6fc0: "No one imagined Lady Miko would die. I still can't believe it.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|706c: "But now there's no one left to lead Hotto. Who are we to rely on...?
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|717c: "To cheer everyone up, the steam bath here will be free for a while.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|722c: "Kind of them, but can this shop really stay afloat like that...?
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|72f4: "Sigh... drinking alone like this reminds me of Lady Miko.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|7364: "Lady Miko loved the sake here. She'd sneak into this bar and drink all night with us.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|7480: "You're the one who helped that lost child, right? That can't-leave-people-alone nature... like Lady Miko's son, Lord Ryu.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|756c: "If Lord Ryu were alive, you two would have got along. Not that it can happen now.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|7684: "Long ago, in my grandfather's grandfather's time, someone stood up to slay the firedrake.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|7740: "They did slay it once, but the slayer vanished, and the firedrake was revived later.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|7840: "So there's a legend that killing the firedrake brings a curse... I'm glad nothing happened to Lord Ryu.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|7b28: "Our child was lost for half a day, but the guard here found him. Anyway, thank goodness he's safe.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|7c44: "Kelp and bonito for the broth~ Simmer tofu and seaweed, then add miso...
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|7ccc: "Oh! You startled me! Don't speak up suddenly while I'm cooking.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|7db0: "Oh, a traveler drawn by the smell of cooking.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|7e28: "Is the smell of soy sauce and miso new to you? They're vital in Hotto. Can't cook without them.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|7f10: "There's an unfamiliar child at the bar. I wonder what happened. I can't help worrying.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|8018: "It's been noisy around the bar lately. What happened? Do you know?
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|80fc: "Oh, is that so... By the way, is that red-hooded girl lost? Take her to her parents.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|8200: "Two lost children in such a small village? What a coincidence.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|82f4: "Is that red-hooded girl lost? Take her to her parents.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|83dc: "Two lost children in such a small village? What a coincidence.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|84e8: "A priest who went to the volcano to prepare for the ritual ran into some ghastly monster on the mountain road to the west.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|85e0: "He barely escaped, and he was so terrified he's still bedridden.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|8708: "Atsuo... Your mother was chosen as the sacrifice, and everyone in the village is grieving.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|87ac: "But understand this: your mother's one life will save everyone in Hotto.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|8860: "I'm a mother too, and I want to protect the children. I know it sounds cold... but please understand.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|89dc: "But why...?! Lady Miko, why did you hide the firedrake...?!
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|8aa0: "You're going after the man-eating firedrake's lair, right? But the mountain gate was locked.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|8b68: "Lady Miko should have the key, so try visiting her shrine. Climb the left-hand stairs.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|8c9c: "You're going after the man-eating firedrake's lair, right?
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|8d20: "The lair is inside Mount Huji, past the mountain gate on the road to the west. Be very careful.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|8e70: "Firedrake, monsters, firedrake again... we've been through so much, but safe life is finally back.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|8f48: "We lost far too much, but there's no time to cry in times like these. We must work hard for Lady Miko too.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|9064: "Not just monsters around, even dogs and cats are getting ornery. And the air feels stale.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|9204: "Not just monsters around, even dogs and cats are getting ornery. And the air feels stale.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|9124: "Oh, how awful... What will become of Hotto?! Someone, do something...!
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|92c4: "Oh, how awful... What will become of Hotto?! Someone, do something...!
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|93a4: "The outside looks scary, but with Lady Miko and Lord Ryu here I'm fine whatever happens.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|956c: "The outside looks scary, but with Lady Miko and Lord Ryu here I'm fine whatever happens.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|9478: "I don't know what's coming outside, but those two would never abandon Hotto...
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|9640: "I don't know what's coming outside, but those two would never abandon Hotto...
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|9930: "After warming up in the village hot spring, rest on a fluffy futon. Now then...
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|9a30: "Oh, you're up. Your companions seem to be talking in the dining hall.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|9ad4: "They seem to be waiting for you, so hurry on.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|9b90: "You seem to be on a hard journey. Whenever you're down or struggling, rest on our futons. Now then...
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|9cd4: "Because of the monsters, customers have all stopped coming. Please do stay with us.
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|9df0: "You're going to defeat the firedrake?! Stay with us and get your strength up!
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|9eec: "I can work like this thanks to you. I made the room spotless, so rest well. Now then...
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|a010: "Thanks to you, more tourists are coming to our village. We're busy. Now then...
id./script/a_060.pack|ie.bxon|a150: "Oh, long time no see. An ominous star floats in the western sky, but at times like this, stay calm and rest...
